'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Richards LS Hidden Base (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base (V) / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers (V)|VB4-L-hiddenbase-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
